_note: Hand-authored effect rules for effects.js (see EFFECT_ENGINE.md). build-data.mjs validates every rule (source exists, op known) and merges these with the GENERATED rules (spell-gem class permissions) into D.effects.rules. via: 'spec' = only while the perk is allocated in the CURRENT specialization (rank > 0); 'spec+anoint' = also when equipped as an Anointment (an anointment counts at the perk's max rank). The 'spec'-only perks below preserve the app's pre-engine behaviour exactly (those perks were never honoured as anointments).

rules._why: Desc says 3, or 5 once every other spec is ascended; the planner assumes the ascended (max) case.
